title: cert chain validation has MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=10 depth limit
description: cert.rs validate_chain() loops for at most MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=10 iterations, returning SmimeError::CertChain('chain too long') if the limit is hit. A future contributor might suggest removing or raising the limit since 'real chains are never that long'. That would be wrong: without a depth bound, a malicious or malformed certificate bag containing a cycle (cert A issued by cert B issued by cert A) would loop forever. The 10-level limit is conservative — real PKIs have 2-4 levels — and ensures that even pathological input terminates with a clear error rather than an infinite loop or stack overflow.
